evidence.quote: For newly added items with a `DOI`, if the `Automatically download PDFs` option is enabled in the preferences, Zotero will attempt to download the attachments automatically.
This plugin utilizes Zotero's built-in [PDF resolvers](https://www.zotero.org/support/kb/custom_pdf_resolvers) feature.

checkNote: README says it writes a Sci-Hub resolver into Zotero's PDF resolvers with pre-configured sites; no key storage found and no AI.
